terminus.status: SYNTHESIS TEST · CAPABILITY CAN BE AN EFFECT
terminus.sourceSays: The paper argues that Taiwan's community-building policy had explicit democratic ideals and, despite possible elite nation-building intentions, its practical operation could positively change people's imagination of the public and promote public participation.
terminus.mutherGenerated: Activation capacity should not be treated only as a pre-existing input that makes a network work. Participation itself can recursively manufacture future activation capacity by changing actors' public imagination, habits and willingness to coordinate. Revised model: topology -> opportunity for interaction; activation capacity -> effective use; repeated participation -> capacity reproduction or decay. This introduces a temporal feedback loop rather than a static sixth diagnostic dimension.

quality.evidence: medium (historical/discourse interpretation rather than causal identification)

terminus.counterexample: The source also warns against reducing outcomes to elite intentions; therefore MUTHER should not infer capacity growth merely from a policy's stated participatory design.
terminus.repeatability: untested; must be attacked with cases where repeated participation produces fatigue, capture or dependency instead of capacity
terminus.next: seek a contrasting source where participation exists repeatedly but activation capacity decays or becomes concentrated
